The witness uses two distinct points of F_2(C) and their common S_2 orbit, so the corrected n=1 identification has no effect. Its owning contract citation was synchronized to the current supplier definition; the item itself is unchanged.

The chart stalk and overlap claims use the affine structure sheaves supplied by Proj, whose construction assumes AC. I added exactly that inherited premise and dependency, retained the explicit prime-extension algebra, and corrected the old no-choice conclusion.
The corollary already assumes AC and declares the choice axiom; its use of chart-prime correspondence in L6 and step 3.1 is within that premise. No statement, proof or dependency needs changing.

Its F1 repeated the literal equality F_1(X)=X. Replacing that fact by the coordinate-evaluation homeomorphism preserves every scaling map and based fundamental-group argument; its Statement remains unchanged.

The n=0 projection is the unique homeomorphism between different singleton constructions; the Statement and L2 now say so. F1 also uses the corrected n=1 coordinate homeomorphism. Covering, connectedness and deck arguments are unchanged.

This definition takes pi_1 at the orbit [q] and uses the covering theorem for path-connectedness. Neither use identifies distinct singleton sets literally, and its n=0 trivial-group conclusion remains valid.

Endpoint monodromy uses the actual fibre S_n q and the covering property, including the trivial S_0 action; it never needs p to be a literal identity. Owning contract citations were synchronized; the item guard is unchanged.

The parity supplier changed its basis presentation, not its Statement or Definition interface for this event. This definition already fixes finite equal-size displayed bases before forming the square odd-to-even matrix.

The communication lemma corrected its total-cost accounting only; this protocol defines the same deterministic prime search, T-round message exchange and terminal evaluation. It contains no invalid use of the old whole-run bound.
The Statement and L9 already assume AC. L1 and step 4.2 use chart stalks within that scope; finite-dimensional chart algebras and Artinian decompositions do not need any further edit.

The definition explicitly assumes AC and imports finite local chart lengths from the zero-dimensional lemma. The new Proj and chart-premise wording is already satisfied for every term of its finite sum.
The supplier only clarified that its row and column product formulas apply for n>=1 while R_t=C_t=S_0 at n=0. This definition already handles the empty partition separately, with S_empty=S_0.
